<think>**Refining one-hot decode simplification**

</think>

{
  "candidate_rtl": "module mux_large (
    input [7:0] block_a, block_b, block_c, block_d, block_e,
    input [7:0] block_f, block_g, block_h, block_i, block_j,
    input [3:0] sel,
    output reg [7:0] block_out
);
    wire en_a, en_b, en_c, en_d, en_e;
    wire en_f, en_g, en_h, en_i, en_j;

    assign en_a = ((~sel[3]) & (~sel[2]) & (~sel[1]) & (~sel[0]))
                | (sel[3] & (sel[2] | sel[1]));
    assign en_b = (~sel[3]) & (~sel[2]) & (~sel[1]) &   sel[0];
    assign en_c = (~sel[3]) & (~sel[2]) &   sel[1]  & (~sel[0]);
    assign en_d = (~sel[3]) & (~sel[2]) &   sel[1]  &   sel[0];
    assign en_e = (~sel[3]) &   sel[2]  & (~sel[1]) & (~sel[0]);
    assign en_f = (~sel[3]) &   sel[2]  & (~sel[1]) &   sel[0];
    assign en_g = (~sel[3]) &   sel[2]  &   sel[1]  & (~sel[0]);
    assign en_h = (~sel[3]) &   sel[2]  &   sel[1]  &   sel[0];
    assign en_i =   sel[3]  & (~sel[2]) & (~sel[1]) & (~sel[0]);
    assign en_j =   sel[3]  & (~sel[2]) & (~sel[1]) &   sel[0];

    always @(*) begin
        block_out = ({8{en_a}} & block_a)
                  | ({8{en_b}} & block_b)
                  | ({8{en_c}} & block_c)
                  | ({8{en_d}} & block_d)
                  | ({8{en_e}} & block_e)
                  | ({8{en_f}} & block_f)
                  | ({8{en_g}} & block_g)
                  | ({8{en_h}} & block_h)
                  | ({8{en_i}} & block_i)
                  | ({8{en_j}} & block_j);
    end
endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline is select-path limited: select decoding and buffering precede multiple data-combination stages, with the worst reported arrival of 1.04 ns from sel[3].",
  "rewrite": "Express the function as an explicit mutually exclusive decoded AND-OR mux. Fold all default selections directly into block_a's enable, avoiding a separate default-selection operation after combining the other data terms. ABC can map the data terms and reduction into NAND/NOR compound structures.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "A timing improvement is plausible from removing separate default-selection logic on the output path, but no mapped candidate result is available. The actual gain relative to 1.04 ns must be established with the specified mapping and STA flow.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Uses ten shared select enables and eighty one-bit data-mask terms before mapping. Decode sharing and compound-gate mapping should keep area competitive, but the 1006.089920 um^2 cap and zero electrical violations remain unverified and require mapped checks.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the module name, absence of parameters, port widths, unsigned inputs, and output reg declaration. Select values 0 through 9 choose block_a through block_j respectively; values 10 through 15 choose block_a. Exactly one enable is asserted for every two-state select value. All data inputs remain unconstrained. The design is fully combinational with no storage, latency, external dependencies, or width-changing arithmetic. Four-state X/Z equivalence is not asserted."
}
